title: Token Pipeline
prompt: Write `buildTheme(base, overrides)` returning the merged token object (`overrides` wins), plus `tokenValue(tokens, path, fallback)` where `path` is dot-separated (e.g. `"color.bg"`) resolving nested tokens; return `fallback` for missing paths.

tests.name: merge with override priority
tests.hint: Shallow merge is fine unless both values are plain objects — then merge recursively one level per call.

tests.name: dot-path resolution with fallback
tests.hint: path.split('.').reduce((o, k) => (o == null ? o : o[k]), tokens) ?? fallback.
